name: Commit
overview: The Scriptures call believers to commit their ways and works fully to the LORD, trusting that He will bring His purposes to pass and establish their thoughts. Delight in the LORD leads to the fulfillment of heartfelt desires, while a transformed mind enables discernment of God's perfect will. Commitment involves a deliberate rolling of one's path and efforts upon God, surrendering personal control and embracing His guidance as good and right.
